title: Played two decks in the card autobattler I’m building with AI assistance — Warbound Realms
author: PalpitationDry2576
selftext:
Played a couple of matches in Warbound Realms and recorded a demon deck and a spell-focused deck :D No commentary, just the gameplay.



I'm the developer. The project uses AI-assisted graphics, text, audio and code, with manual design, editing, implementation and testing. The footage is a look at how those pieces work together during an actual match.



One thing I want to judge through playtesting is whether the card art and effects communicate what's happening once several units are on the board. A card can look good on its own and still be hard to read in combat. If you work with AI-assisted art too, how do you check that it stays readable at gameplay size? And watching these two decks, where does the action become hard to follow?
